THE 4 SEASONS 1/ GETTING TO KNOW YOU When you apply, we'll send you a link to psychometric tests that will help us assess your soft skills, reasoning, analytical ability, preferred work style, communication, and other interesting details.​ 1.1/ CODE STATION (DEVS ONLY) If you apply for a Development position, we'll invite you to a coding challenge to assess your programming style and current knowledge level, although we know you're always eager to learn. It's important to be transparent during this test and avoid using AI assistance, as you'll be asked about your code during the interview.​ 2/ A BRIEF PAUSE We need to review your results, so please allow 1 to 3 days for us to contact you and let you know the next steps in the process. 3/ TIME TO MEET THE VAUXOO TEAM We'd love to meet you and give you a chance to get to know us. We'll send you a form to schedule a meeting where we can evaluate if this is the opportunity we're both looking for. After this, you'll receive a response about your application within 1 to 5 days. Anterior Siguiente Contact us for job opportunities. A MESSAGE FROM OUR CEO We're Thrilled that you are considering joining the Vauxoo Team! ​ In this virtual - Digital - in-person - remote space, we're exited to grow and see new faces that add to our cultural and professional diversity. This amazing community consists of people from different nationalities, profiles and age ranges united by one common need: to do extraordinary things. At Vauxoo, we like to do things exeptionally; valuing curiosity, initiative, and openness to the exchange of knowledge because we recognize its the best way for you to learn from each member, and for each member to learn from you.
